title: RippleState
key_points: RippleState is a type of ledger entry in the XRP Ledger.
It represents a change in the state of the Ripple consensus protocol.
RippleState entries are used to communicate updates from one validator to another.
They can contain data such as changes to transaction costs, fees, and other parameters.
RippleState entries are validated by the XRP Ledger's consensus mechanism.
limitations: The source does not discuss potential limitations or drawbacks of using RippleState entries in applications.
It assumes familiarity with the XRP Ledger and its architecture.
The scope is limited to technical details rather than broader implications or critiques.
asserts: RippleState is an essential type of ledger entry that enables validators to communicate and enforce changes to the Ripple consensus protocol's configuration and behavior.
scope: Describes the purpose, usage, and impact of RippleState entries within the technical context of the XRP Ledger's consensus mechanism.
